01

“and the earth brings out its burdens”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 99:2).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the earth brings out its burdens [al-Zalzalah: 2], he said: “He says: it brought out those who are in the graves.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا [الزلزلة: 2] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ: «أَخْرَجَتْ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ»

02

“That Day, it will report its news”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 99:4).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
That Day, it will report its news [al-Zalzalah: 4]: “it will report the news of the people, of what they did upon it of good or evil.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا [الزلزلة: 4] «تُحَدِّثُ بِأَخْبَارِ النَّاسِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا عَلَيْهَا مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ شَرٍّ»

03

“because your Lord has inspired it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 99:5).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
because your Lord has inspired it [al-Zalzalah: 5], he says: “He commanded it, so it cast out what was in it and emptied itself of them.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَى لَهَا [الزلزلة: 5] يَقُولُ: «أَمَرَهَا فَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ مِنْهُمْ»
